source_sql:
SELECT last_name, salary FROM employees
ORDER  BY salary DESC
OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY

fetch.scalardb_sql: SELECT employee_id, last_name, salary FROM hr.employees

java.sql: SELECT last_name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC NULLS FIRST OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY

python.sql: SELECT last_name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5 OFFSET 5

notes: java: Oracle semantics made explicit for H2 (date functions, NULL ordering)

recommended_config.isolation_note: SERIALIZABLE re-executes every scan at commit; SNAPSHOT or READ_COMMITTED avoids it but applies to the whole node
